text:
Anna: Heads-up — ran an int8 bringup for concord-v2-embed on the wiki holdout. quick summary: recall@1 dropped noticeably.
Chris: ugh, numbers?
Anna: short paste: ```
# command
python infra/eval/embed_eval.py --model concord-v2 --quant int8 --dataset wiki_holdout.csv --norm l2 --k 5
# output (sample)
N=5000 recall@1:0.410 recall@5:0.740 mAP:0.562 avg_sim:0.618 silhouette:0.21
baseline (fp16) recall@1:0.483 recall@5:0.755 silhouette:0.24
``` 
Sylvia: that's ~7 pts relative drop at r@1, silhouette down 0.03. shape of clusters changed in UMAP — long-tail IDs got merged.
Leo: did you do per-channel vs per-tensor quant? calibration steps?
Anna: default run was per-tensor symmetric, 128 calibration samples (random). no per-channel yet.
Chris: try per-channel and increase calibration to 5k, also try layerwise scaling (range-based). sometimes embedding heads need separate scale.
Sylvia: also try L2-normalize BEFORE quant (we quantized raw vectors in that run). quantizing normalized vectors often preserves nearest-neighbor ordering.
Anna: good point. reran quick with pre-normalize + per-channel (calib 5k): ```
# quick rerun
python infra/eval/embed_eval.py --model concord-v2 --quant int8 --calib 5000 --per_channel True --norm l2
# sample
N=5000 recall@1:0.472 recall@5:0.748 silhouette:0.235
``` 
Anna: much better — r@1 nearly recovered, silhouette even slightly above baseline. so quantization setup mattered.
Chris: nice. that suggests distribution of components has heavy skew — per-tensor collapsed some dims.
Leo: can we reproduce across other holdouts? longtail / faq / multilingual?
Anna: running batch now across multilingual_holdout + faq_small. ETA ~20m. EvalBot will post results.
EvalBot: scheduled job started: job_id=job-20260315-77, datasets=[multilingual_holdout,faq_small], config={quant:int8,per_channel:true,norm:l2,calib:5000}
Sylvia: add a small ablation: int8 per-channel but no normalization; also a float16 run to isolate quantization rounding vs scale.
Chris: add a quick test of asymmetric quant vs symmetric — sometimes asymmetric helps with nonzero-mean dims.
Anna: added. also logging per-dim max/min and kurtosis to spot heavy-tailed dims.
Leo: if per-channel + normalize consistently recovers, we should bake that into the onboard recipe and annotate in model catalog (notes: concord-v2 int8 needs pre-normalize + per-channel cal=5k).
Sylvia: agree. also add unit test: recall@1 delta <= 0.02 vs fp16 on wiki_holdout for PR gating.
Anna: creating PR for eval harness and a short doc blurb.
Chris: one more: add small clustering plot snapshot (UMAP) to the PR so reviewers can eyeball cluster topology.
Anna: will attach. action items:
- Anna: finish full runs and upload CSVs + plots (today)
- Leo: draft model-catalog note for quant recipe
- Sylvia: add unit gating test in CI
- Chris: quick perf run to measure throughput/cost delta int8 vs fp16
Sylvia: thanks — great triage. :thumbsup:
Anna: thanks all. will post results when jobs finish. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
